title: Quinone-heme π-π interactions bridge the biotic-abiotic interface for enhanced methanogenesis
authors: Zhihao Jiang, Zhiqiang Zhao, Qilin Yu, et al.
abstract: Quinone-based conductive materials promote extracellular electron transfer and methanogenesis during anaerobic digestion, in which the material mediates the transfer of electrons produced from exoelectrogens to electrotrophic methanogens, but the underlying mechanism remains elusive. Here, the authors establish the electron transfer interface between reduced anthraquinone (H₂AQC) and Methanosarcin

title: The Fanconi anemia pathway restrains MLL-rearranged leukemogenesis through suppressing non-homologous end joining-mediated genomic instability
authors: Jian Xu, Logan M. Sund, Emily V. Wolff, et al.
abstract: Mutations in the Fanconi anemia (FA) DNA repair genes predispose to leukemia and bone marrow failure. Here, the authors discover that the FA pathway controls MLL-rearranged leukemia progression via blocking nonhomologous end joining-mediated genomic instability.

title: Topological valley quasi-bound states in the continuum for radiatively accessible robust transport
authors: Minggui Wei, Yang Long, Gui-Geng Liu, et al.
abstract: Topological valley photonics enables robust on-chip light transport, but valley edge states lie outside the light cone, blocking free-space excitation. Here, authors fold these states into topological valley quasi-bound states in the continuum, enabling free-space coupling while preserving low-loss terahertz transport.

title: The changing surface of the world’s roads
authors: Sukanya Randhawa, Guntaj Randhawa, Clemens Langer, et al.
abstract: Researchers created a global, multi-temporal map of road surfaces and widths from satellite imagery, covering 9.2 million km of roads. The dataset reveals infrastructure change, connectivity gaps, and resilience patterns worldwide.
